title: Working as a young porter in the district
summary: Watkins was too young to enter the dance halls and police restricted youngsters; he describes working 12-hour night shifts as a bellhop.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: One thing about the district, can you remember anything more? Here it is. Anything more about the music and the district when you were a porter?

Well, when I was working around there, Bill, I wasn't allowed in them places because I was too young at that time because I was just like I said I was 13 years old. And even when I got to be 16 years old, I wasn't allowed in them places, in the dance halls at night, you know.

Because police was pretty strict on youngsters out there in them days. You see anybody just side of Claiborne Street that was in short pants couldn't venture across Claiborne between Iverville to St. Louis to go in town. You either had to go around St. Louis Street or go out Canal Street. You couldn't pass through the old Tenderloin District.

Couldn't walk through there at all unless you was with some of your parents. There was the only way you could get through there. But see what made me go in short pants or long pants so early? We was living on Marais between Cornelis and St. Louis. Well, that was a part of the old Tenderloin District. So the police didn't advise my mother to get me a pair of long pants or either she'd have to move out.

So my uncle gave me my first pair of long pants to go to, and I went to work the following week. Frederick Brown had wanted the bellhop and I went to work around there working at night from 2 in the evening to 2 in the morning. I worked 12 hours during them days around there. Yeah. But he was making money. But the night shifts were the best because that's when everything was opening up and all the, you know, spokesmen coming through that going to different houses and that's where we used to make our money. It wasn't nothing in the daytime because practically everybody was asleep.
So I made pretty good money. My salary was four and a half a week. But I was pulling down over. I'm about $35 and $40 in them days a week. I'm about to get a little bit of a job. Excuse my salary.
But I was a child, well I gave it all to my parents.
